policy: JUnit XML report output compatibility: existing runs must retain unlimited captured output unless the user opts in. Existing junit_logging and junit_log_passing_tests filtering must keep working. Failure and error diagnostics must not be truncated by an output limit. Lina Imani owns the reporting behavior decision; ask her to confirm the limit units, zero meaning and truncation marker before shipping. Owen Vale owns the configuration documentation and changelog for this project. The exact setting name and limit units have not been approved yet.
